body:
### Describe the feature or problem you’d like to solve

Currently, `gh run list` will display `* ✓ X`, but 'failure' and 'cancelled' are both `X`, which is difficult to distinguish

### Proposed solution

Change the icon of 'cancelled' to a gray `!`

### Additional context

Add any other context like screenshots or mockups are helpful, if applicable.

comments.body: Confirmed by code inspection: in `Symbol()` (https://github.com/operator/sample/blob/819f972eff771d5ec433c8d03c369cc43f1eab49/pkg/cmd/run/shared/shared.go#L600-L614), both `Failure` and `Cancelled` conclusions fall into the shared `default` branch, which returns the red failure icon (`cs.FailureIconWithColor`). This means `gh run list` currently has no visual way to tell a cancelled run apart from a faile

title: `gh run list` show cancelled jobs icon
